title: Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) Covered-Visit Allowance on Non-Covered Items
content:
**Rule.** An insured Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) account classified medically necessary or emergency whose deductible, coinsurance and copay liability postings total above 0.00 (a non-covered item inside a covered visit) adds 2.5 percentage points to the non-covered discount percent; an account so classified with no such cost-sharing posted (a visit the payer covered none of) adds 5 percentage points; an account classified elective non-covered adds none.

## Condition, judgement, result

| Service classification | Deductible, coinsurance and copay postings | Reading | Points added |
|---|---|---|---|
| medically necessary or emergency | total above 0.00 | non-covered item inside a covered visit | 2.5 |
| medically necessary or emergency | none posted | visit the payer covered none of | 5 |
| elective non-covered | any | none | none |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- An emergency account with a 150.00 copay and a 400.00 non-covered-service posting adds 2.5 points.
- A medically necessary account whose only liability is a 900.00 non-covered-service posting adds 5 points.
- An elective non-covered account adds no points whatever its cost-sharing.
